chunk: displayName: "Home Depot Service Center (HD Portal) — Home Depot's proprietary lead management and contract system for Pro contractor partners"

knownQuirks: [
  "**Lead identifier is the F-number, NOT a UUID or numeric ID:** Lead lookups in HD Portal use the 'F number' (lead number). When asking the client to share a test lead ID, ask explicitly for the 'F number' — generic 'lead ID' will produce confusion (e.g. SFIM vendor number was offered instead). (Source: peerless transcript, 2026-04-17 — Venkat B / Ashley Salerno exchange.)",
  "**Polling lag is documented at 10 minutes (was 30):** HD Portal-to-Salesforce sync updates happen on a ~10-minute cadence per Home Depot ('Marcos told that update every ten minutes' — was 30 minutes historically). Design integrations for at-least-10-minute eventual consistency; do not assume real-time on lead → CRM propagation. (Source: peerless transcript, 2026-04-14.)",
  "**Existing HD → Salesforce lead sync is partially broken:** Ashley Salerno: 'when we create a lead inside of Home Depot Service Center, it doesn't come through inside of Salesforce. So that part needs to be fixed.' Any new integration must NOT rely on the legacy sync being correct — verify per-lead via GET against HD Portal as the source of truth. (Source: peerless transcript, 2026-04-14.)",
  "**Credentials are delivered through 'confidential email' that blocks copy-paste:** HD Portal API credentials are sent via secure email that disables clipboard copy. Recipients must transcribe by hand or screenshot+OCR. Beware: 'AI can hallucinate, so you may get a wrong password — don't lock yourself out' (Raghuram Potluri).
